latest.title: Infant carry slings rarely linked to OHCA
latest.finding: Only 2 of 162 OHCA were carry sling-associated (1.8% of the 114 infant cases); co-sleeping accounted for 33.3% and children found unresponsive 26.3%

latest.title: No unique GCS 8 threshold for intubation
latest.finding: Recorded intubation was 9.1–10.6 percentage points more frequent at GCS 8 (pooled aOR 1.61, 95% CI 1.36–1.91), but model fit favoured a graded GCS–outcome relationship over a discrete jump at the 8/9 boundary in every outcome and both eras

latest.title: Paediatric deterioration in the field poorly defined
latest.finding: No study offered an operational definition of paediatric out-of-hospital deterioration; research leans on single-timepoint vital signs, trauma-specific indices and hospital-derived early warning scores, and no study examined physiological trajectories

latest.title: Paediatric care coordinators linked to fewer EMS errors
latest.finding: Coordinator agencies performed more procedures (55.4% vs 26.8%) and gave more medications (23.4% vs 7.7%); procedure adverse safety event rates were 13.7% vs 20.0%, with lower assigned harm severity
